summary: This note describes the South Carolina Gamecocks baseball team, which represents the University of South Carolina in NCAA Division I college baseball. It highlights the program's sustained success since 1970, including multiple NCAA Tournament and College World Series appearances and two national championships in 2010 and 2011. It also notes records at the College World Series and the team's Southeastern Conference membership since 1992.
one_line: Overview of the University of South Carolina's NCAA Division I baseball program, its postseason record and back-to-back national titles in 2010 and 2011.
key_facts: The South Carolina Gamecocks baseball team represents the University of South Carolina in NCAA Division I college baseball.
South Carolina has been one of the best teams in college baseball since 1970, according to the note.
The Gamecocks have posted 31 NCAA Tournament appearances.
The Gamecocks have made 11 College World Series berths.
The Gamecocks have made 6 College World Series Finals appearances.
South Carolina won 2 NCAA National Championships, in 2010 and 2011.
Carolina is one of six schools in NCAA history to win back-to-back titles.
Since joining the Southeastern Conference in 1992, the team has competed in the Eastern division.
South Carolina owns a 32-18 record at the College World Series.
South Carolina holds the NCAA record for consecutive wins (22) in the national tournament.
South Carolina holds the longest win streak ever at the College World Series, at 12 in a row from 2010 to 2012.
The Gamecocks played for national titles in all three years of their 2010 to 2012 College World Series run.
